name: AMBEST
recent: Ambest 近期推进员工认股计划（ESOS），规模由最多30%缩减至最多10%，并撤回额外上市申请；同时董事与大股东在9月有多笔股权变动。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长19.2%，净利环比大增801.8%。
notable: 规模修订为最多占已发行股份10%，并撤回额外上市申请。
董事经理 Tan Beng Beng 与执行董事 Lim Eng Guan 于2026年9月3日及11日各有多笔股份出售。
最新季度营收环比增长19.2%，净利环比增长801.8%。
risks: ESOS 若实施可能稀释现有股东权益。
董事及大股东在9月有多笔股份出售。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为2428.2万令吉，环比增长19.2%；净利为343.6万令吉，环比增长801.8%，净利率由1.9%升至14.2%。

recent_en: Ambest recently progressed its proposed ESOS, scaled down from up to 30% to up to 10%, and withdrew the additional listing application; meanwhile directors and substantial shareholders had several shareholding changes in September. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue rose 19.2% QoQ and net profit jumped 801.8% QoQ.
notable_en: Proposed establishment of an ESOS, revised to up to 10% of issued shares, with the additional listing application withdrawn.
Managing Director Tan Beng Beng and Executive Director Lim Eng Guan each had several share disposals on 3 and 11 September 2026.
Latest quarter revenue rose 19.2% QoQ and net profit rose 801.8% QoQ.
risks_en: The ESOS, if implemented, may dilute existing shareholders' equity.
Directors and substantial shareholders made several share disposals in September.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR24.282 million, up 19.2% QoQ; net profit was MYR3.436 million, up 801.8% QoQ, with net margin rising from 1.9% to 14.2%.
